描述_EN: a production of one of the imperial looms; intended to be worn by the emperor or a prince of the blood. the design presents a medley of confucian, buddhist and daoist symbolism. density 60x90 threads/sq.cm, cross- sectional width of warp 0.1mm, of weft 0.2mm. confucianism is symbolized by the battle-axe and the pair of sacrificial wine-cups. three five-clawed dragons rise from the waves of the sea, encircled by clouds. the upper dragon represented full-face is coiled round a cosmic medallion with the shou (longevity) character in the centre surrounded by the hanging musical stone, the peach, bat and magic fungus, the attributes of the eight daoist immortals and other emblens as signs of long life and felicity. back of a robe of silk tapestry (kesi), woven in coloured silks and gold thread on a yellow ground. the pair of dragons below grasp the flaming jewel of the buddhist law. the cloud spaces are filled in with diverse forms of the shou character, flying bats, jewelled sceptres and floral sprays.
描述_ZN: a production of one of the imperial looms; intended to be worn by the emperor or a prince of the blood. 该设计呈现了儒家、佛教和道家的混合象征。 密度60x90线/平方厘米，经线截面宽度0.1mm，纬线截面宽度0.2mm。 儒家的象征是斧头和一对祭祀用的酒杯。 三条五爪龙从大海的波浪中升起，被云层包围着。 上层的龙正面盘绕着一个宇宙徽章，中心是寿字，周围是悬铃木、桃子、蝙蝠、魔耳、八仙的属性以及其他象征长寿和幸福的徽章。 丝织品长袍的背面，由彩色丝绸和金线在黄地上编织而成。 下面的一对龙抓住了佛法的火焰宝珠。 云层中充满了各种形式的寿字、飞蝠、宝杖和花草。
